Gearing up and we received the Ops phone on 28%.

Welfare check on Wyndham st chemist warehouse, all clear, no issues to report.

We got a response call from Mecca queen street regarding a male vagrant being verbally abusive and aggressive. The store manager wanted the male to be trespassed so we issued a verball trespass notice to the male and that he will be arrested if he returns to the store again.
We got a response call from a staff member from UCG express who was verbally abused by a male vagrant and that same vagrant kept harrassing customers inside the store.

We got a request from staff from the Peter Alexander store on queen st to remove the same vagrant from there store because he kept harassing staff members, we got him out and told him to move along. Standing by on queen street and keeping a close eye on stores.

A staff member from Glassons approached us and asked if we could remove the same vagrant from there store because he was harassing staff inside the store and kept making everyone feel uncomfortable, we got him out of the store and told him to move further down the street, standing by outside glassons maintaining presence.

While walking down towards towards Commercial bay, we got approached from staff from Lovisa regarding that same male vagrant, he was again yelling a verbally abusing staff and other members of the public, we arrived in the store and got him out. Standing by outside the store.

Full sweep commercial bay completed, standing by maintaining visible presence.
Sweep Lower albert street all clear, no issues to report.
Sweep Customs st west all clear. No issues to report.
Sweep Custom street East all clear, no issues to report.

Sweep chancery square, all clear, no issues to report.
Sweep Kitchener st, Victoria st east all clear, welfare check on Looksharpe, no issues to report.
Heading back to HQ to start our break.
We got a response call from unichem queen st regarding a female who shoplifted and stole a few items.
We arrived at the store and managed to get a good description of the female. Standing by along queen street and monitoring retail activity.

We found the female in cotton on queen st, we approached her and asked her to return the items that she stole, she was non compliant and kept walking away, she stopped on the top on Victoria street near the 77 convenience store when we said we'd contact the police, she handed over the stolen items, no further issues, heading to HQ to finish off our reports and our auror reports.
Arrived HQ, finishing off reports and standing by for calls.
Morning shift completed, Handover to Afternoon shift completed, Equipment checked and accounted for.
